$$
x=2u-v,\,y=3u+2,\,z=u+2v
$$

for $0\le u\le 5$ and $-1\le v\le 1.$" :question/worked-solution "For a surface $S$ with parametrization $r(u,v)$ for $(u,v)\in D,$ the surface area of $S$ is given by

$$
{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖\text{d}A.
$$

In vector form, our surface has the equation 

$$
r(u,v)=⟨2u-v,\,3u+2,\,u+2v⟩.
$$

We first compute the tangent vectors to the grid curves:

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}_{u}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂u},\,\frac{∂y}{∂u},\,\frac{∂z}{∂u}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂u}(2u-v),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(3u+2),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(u+2v)⟩ \\  & =⟨2,\,3,\,1⟩ \\ {r}_{v}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂v},\,\frac{∂y}{∂v},\,\frac{∂z}{∂v}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂v}(2u-v),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(3u+2),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(u+2v)⟩ \\  & =⟨-1,\,0,\,2⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, the fundamental vector product is

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′} & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 2 & 3 & 1 \\ -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =⟨|\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|,\,-|\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}|,\,|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}|⟩ \\  & =⟨6,\,-5,\,3⟩,\end{aligned}
$$

and 

$$
\begin{aligned}‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖ & =‖⟨6,\,-5,\,3⟩‖ \\  & =\sqrt{{6}^{2}+(-5)^{2}+{3}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{36+25+9} \\  & =\sqrt{70}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, let's denote

$$
D={(u,v)\,:\,0\le u\le 5,\,-1\le v\le 1}.
$$

Then, the surface area is

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{70}\,\text{d}A \\  & =\sqrt{70}{∬}_{D}\text{ }\,\text{d}A \\  & =\sqrt{70}\cdot \text{Area}(D) \\  & =\sqrt{70}\cdot 5\cdot 2 \\  & =10 \sqrt{70}.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["598cd05f-a758-55c1-9174-123016a1cdf8"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "7c8f8746-3757-5c4f-81cf-138acecbfbba" "Find the surface area of the part of the parametric surface $r(u,v)=⟨-u+v,\,u-2v,\,3v⟩$ that is subject to the constraint ${u}^{2}+{v}^{2}\le 20.$" :question/worked-solution "For a surface $S$ with parametrization $r(u,v)$ for $(u,v)\in D,$ the surface area of $S$ is given by

$$
{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖\text{d}A.
$$

We first compute the tangent vectors to the grid curves:

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}_{u}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂u},\,\frac{∂y}{∂u},\,\frac{∂z}{∂u}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂u}(-u+v),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(u-2v),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(3v)⟩ \\  & =⟨-1,\,1,\,0⟩ \\ {r}_{v}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂v},\,\frac{∂y}{∂v},\,\frac{∂z}{∂v}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂v}(-u+v),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(u-2v),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(3v)⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,-2,\,3⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the fundamental vector product is

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′} & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =⟨|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -2 & 3\end{aligned}|,\,-|\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}|,\,|\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}|⟩ \\  & =⟨3,\,3,\,1⟩,\end{aligned}
$$

and 

$$
\begin{aligned}‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖ & =‖⟨3,\,3,\,1⟩‖ \\  & =\sqrt{{3}^{2}+{3}^{2}+{1}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{9+9+1} \\  & =\sqrt{19}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, notice that the region ${u}^{2}+{v}^{2}\le 20$ corresponds to the disk

$$
D={(u,v)\,:\,{u}^{2}+{v}^{2}\le 20},
$$

of radius $2 \sqrt{5}.$

Therefore, the surface area is

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}\,\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\sqrt{19}\,\text{d}A \\  & =\sqrt{19}{∬}_{D}\text{d}A \\  & =\sqrt{19}\cdot \text{Area}(D) \\  & =\sqrt{19}\cdot (\pi \cdot (2 \sqrt{5})^{2}) \\  & =20 \sqrt{19} \pi.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["f72f9232-4b2e-53c4-9085-4f50862a7a79"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "92f3e1ca-f67b-5933-9d82-67166ccbf4d0" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186119888.py"} [:db/add 17592186119888 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186119888 :knowledge-point/questions ["0f95e766-a2a3-5446-8a69-b8c1d5e53063" "e42dd0ba-94bb-571f-b81d-083720a4e84b"]} [:db/ensure 17592186119888 :knowledge-point/validate]]
